description: This file implements a state machine engine with event queues, state transitions, and event processing functions for a voice SDK component.

methods.name: SmInit
methods.description: Initializes the state machine with a starting state and resets event queues.

methods.name: SmInThisState
methods.description: Checks if the state machine is currently in a specified state.

methods.name: SmSetThisState
methods.description: Sets the current state of the state machine.

methods.name: SmEnqueueEvent
methods.description: Enqueues an event into the active event queue for processing.

methods.name: SmProcessEvents
methods.description: Processes all queued events and deferred events, handling state transitions.
